title: Preserve final-turn watcher attribution when the pending generation outlasts the grace window
outcome: Pending workspace event batching does not omit or misattribute final-turn changes or settle delegation observations before the relevant pending changes are accounted for.
acceptance: A deterministic regression covers continuous unrelated traffic and a write near turn completion, with generation delay exceeding the existing 750 ms grace, and verifies attribution to the original turn.

A delegation-settlement regression accounts for pending last-window file changes without observing post-settlement writes or crossing attempts; the implemented synchronization retains bounded pending storage and avoids state-lock inversion.
